UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Private student profile containing personal identity and class assignment.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the student.

email.description: Verified student email address (PII, owner-only access).

LeaderboardEntry.title: LeaderboardEntry
LeaderboardEntry.description: Public non-PII student ranking and cumulative quiz points.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID matching the document ID.

displayName.description: Student display name shown on the leaderboard.

className.description: Student class name shown on the leaderboard.

totalScore.description: All-time cumulative score from both stations.

weeklyScore.description: Current ISO week score from both stations.

weekKey.description: ISO week identifier for weekly leaderboard resets.

wordPowerScore.description: Cumulative score earned in Station 1 Word Power.

grammarScore.description: Cumulative score earned in Station 2 Grammar & Structure.

quizzesCompleted.description: Total number of quizzes completed across stations.

isPublic.description: Explicit visibility flag for public leaderboard queries.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest score update.

QuizAttempt.title: QuizAttempt
QuizAttempt.description: Immutable record of a student's completed quiz attempt in either station.

maxScore.description: Total number of questions in the quiz.

weekKey.description: ISO week key when the quiz was submitted.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the attempt was recorded.

/users/{userId}.description: Private student account profiles isolated by UID.

/users/{userId}/quizAttempts/{attemptId}.description: Individual student quiz attempt history under the parent user document.

/leaderboard/{userId}.description: Public real-time student leaderboard entries without PII.
